A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''[[Human/Legends|Human]] Rebel''', who had a large scar running from his left [[Eye/Legends|eye]] to the right side of his jaw, was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] team sent to investigate [[Gobindi]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] soon put the world under lockdown as it tested the [[influenza necrosi]] virus, declaring the reason for the lockdown to be [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]]. The Empire discovered the Rebel agents' presence, and declared them to be wanted as [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].

After a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Unidentified Rodian Rebel|member]] of the team was arrested, the Human Rebel, [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], and a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Unidentified Bothan Rebel|confederate]] confronted [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]], asking for her help in escaping the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. While they spoke, the Human Rebel was attacked by a [[blob]] creature carrying influenza necrosi. Though his allies pulled the blob off, he was infected, and soon collapsed. Antilles and the Bothan took him back to their safe house.

==Behind the scenes==
The Human Rebel character appears in ''[[Galaxy of Fear: Planet Plague]]'', in which he is last seen infected with the deadly influenza necrosi virus. The book never makes it clear whether the man survived long enough to receive the cure later created by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Kavafi]].
